questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: 'あいにくですが、これだけです。 (Ainiku desu ga, kore dake desu.)' Select the appropriate English response.
The instructor said: '一キロ、千円と千五百円ですが (Ichi-kiro, sen-en to sen-gohyaku-en desu ga)' Select the appropriate English response.

answers.answer: (Please give me 2kg of the one that is 1,500 yen.)
(I'll take one of the red ones.)

questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: '白いのと、赤いのがこちらにございます。 (Shiroi no to, akai no ga kochira ni gozaimasu.)' Select the appropriate English response.

answers.answer: (I'll take one of the red ones.)
(Please give me 2kg of the one that is 1,500 yen.)

questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: '百グラム三百円と四百円です。 (Hyaku-guramu sanbyaku-en to yonhyaku-en desu.)' Select the appropriate English response.

answers.answer: (Please give me 500g of the one that is 300 yen.)
(I'll take one of the blue ones.)

questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: '百グラム千円と千三百円です。 (Hyaku-guramu sen-en to sen-sanbyaku-en desu.)' Select the appropriate English response.

answers.answer: (I'll take 200g of the one that is 1,300 yen.)

questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: 'こちらは一つ千三百円で、そちらは、一つ千五百円でございます。 (Kochira wa hitotsu sen-sanbyaku-en de, sochira wa hitotsu sen-gohyaku-en de gozaimasu.)' Select the appropriate English response.

answers.answer: (I'll take two of those that are 1,300 yen each.)
(I'll take 200g of the one that is 1,300 yen.)

questions_and_answers.question: The instructor said: 'こちらは百グラム五百円で、そちらは百グラム八百円ですが。 (Kochira wa hyaku-guramu gohyaku-en de, sochira wa hyaku-guramu happyaku-en desu ga.)' Select the appropriate English response.

answers.answer: (Give me two of those that are 800 yen each.)
(Give me 200g of the one that is 500 yen.)
